summary: Backend-only verification of PWA logo fix (iter75). Confirmed the user-reported bug is resolved: PWAInstallPrompt.jsx and GlobalNavMenu.jsx now reference /logo-mark.svg?v=11 (verified in source AND in the built bundle at /app/frontend/build/static/js/main.e870688e.js). No stale /logo-mark.png reference remains in the bundle. index.html icon cache-busters are ALL at ?v=12 (favicon, icon-192, icon-512, logo-mark.svg, og-banner) with no stale ?v=10 / ?v=11. Service-worker VERSION = 'v12-logo-final'. Served /logo-mark.svg is 200 image/svg+xml and contains the new BlueOcean shopping-bag shape (M36 50) + accent-dot (circle cx=92 cy=28). manifest.json lists all 5 icons and each returns 200 with correct content-type. All 7 raster PNGs on disk have mtime newer than the Aug 30 2026 cutoff. 23/23 iter75 asset tests pass. Auth regression: 16/16 tests in test_auth_deep_investigation.py pass. Email endpoints /api/otp/request and /api/verify/email/send are reachable and correctly return 401 for unauthenticated calls (by design — both depend on get_current_user).

Both /api/otp/request and /api/verify/email/send have always required auth (Depends(get_current_user)) and correctly return 401 to unauthenticated callers. They remain reachable and behave identically to pre-fix. No regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter75 fixed the PWA install prompt showing the old logo. Root cause: PWAInstallPrompt.jsx line 119 and GlobalNavMenu.jsx line 71 hard-linked /logo-mark.png without a cache-buster. Fix swapped to /logo-mark.svg?v=11. index.html icons bumped to ?v=12, service-worker to v12-logo-final. Built bundle main.e870688e.js verified to contain 'logo-mark.svg?v=11' and NO stale '/logo-mark.png'. All served assets, manifest, and SW verified against the public URL. Next iteration can re-use /app/backend/tests/test_iteration75_pwa_logo_fix.py as regression coverage.
rca of the issue: USER BUG: 'Add to Home Screen' PWA prompt showed the pre-rebrand logo. RCA: Two React components hard-referenced /logo-mark.png with no cache-buster query string, so browsers/PWA cache held onto pre-rebrand bytes even after the PNG on disk was regenerated. Mitigation applied by main agent: (1) switched both components to /logo-mark.svg?v=11 (self-contained SVG that already carries the new brand), (2) bumped every icon reference in index.html to ?v=12, (3) bumped service-worker VERSION to v12-logo-final so the SW cache purges on next visit, (4) rebuilt via `yarn build` and restarted frontend supervisor. Verified end-to-end via public URL.
